primaryTextRead.text: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryTextRead.text: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

wikipediaRead.title: Hiram I
wikipediaRead.locator: Lead identifies Hiram I as a Phoenician king of Tyre in the Hebrew Bible; Reign discusses his alliance with Solomon and references the biblical account. This supports a limited king-of-Tyre association, not the debated chronology.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版記事は聖書に登場するティルスのフェニキア王ヒラムを扱い、ソロモンとの関係を記しています。年代についての議論はこの人物説明に取り込みません。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The article identifies a Tyrian king in the Hebrew Bible and describes the Solomon alliance; precise chronology is debated in the article.
